source: one REAL_ROOT brain registered internally (task0042-seed-proof.py) -> the harness moves the whole root out of its path, outside the process -> real Actualiser click refused -> badge read back from the backend (map_source_observation) -> REAL process restart with the source still absent -> Ouvrir shows the map and the persisted observation -> the same folder put back -> real Actualiser -> a different root at the same path -> refused, then Reconstruire; the outcome of each IPC is read from the Tauri-Response header on the wire (CDP Network), every state from the real badge and panels
limits: No personal brain: the analysed tree was generated by task0042-seed-proof.py and dies with the proof root

The absence is a folder MOVED away from its path by the harness (a real ROOT_NOT_FOUND); a permission-denied root, an unplugged drive or a network share are not fabricated — their classification is proved at the Rust level on closed reasons only

SCAN_INCOMPLETE and APPLY_FAILED are dangerous or artificial to provoke in the real host and are proved at the Rust level (source_availability_tests: a directory vanishing during the scan, fixture drift, an injected SQL failure with exact rollback)

The badge states the LAST observation. Nothing here observes the source in the background: detection stays manual, and no watcher or polling exists (F-030 is out of scope), so F-032 is a foundation, not a completed feature
Development workstation; not a modest-laptop acceptance test
